grammar.summary: 本课以「误把慢车当快车」为线索，集中运用了被动语态、主语从句与情态动词表推测，并出现 neither/nor 倒装。重点体会叙事中如何用被动突出「被耽误、被拦住」，用 it 作形式主语引出推测，用倒装表「也（不）」。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: 当要突出动作的承受者时用被动语态：be + 过去分词。本课用被动叙述「轮船被风暴延误、航班被取消、快车被信号拦住、服务被打乱」，主语为承受者，语气客观。

examples.en: Ships may be delayed by storms; flights may be cancelled because of bad weather, but trains must be on time.
examples.cn: 轮船船期可能因风暴而推延，飞机航班可能因恶劣天气而取消，唯有火车必然是准点的。

examples.en: Only an exceptionally heavy snowfall might temporarily dislocate railway services.
examples.cn: 只有非同寻常的大雪才可能暂时打乱铁路运行。

examples.en: Even a mighty express train can be held up by signals.
examples.cn: 因为即便是特别快车也可能被信号拦住。

points.title: 主语从句与 it 形式主语 (Subject Clauses & Formal it)
points.explanation: 用 it 作形式主语，把真正的主语从句后置，常用于 It struck me that / It dawned on me that / It is all too easy to 等结构。本课用 It suddenly dawned on me that 引出「突然意识到」的内容。

examples.en: It is all too easy to blame the railway authorities when something does go wrong.
examples.cn: 因此，一旦铁路上真出了问题，人们便不加思索地责备铁路当局。

examples.en: It suddenly dawned on me that this express was not roaring down the line at ninety miles an hour, but barely chugging along at thirty.
examples.cn: 我突然感到这趟快车并没以时速90英里的速度呼啸前进，而是卟哧卟哧地向前爬行，时速仅30英里。

points.title: neither/nor 倒装 (Negative Inversion)
points.explanation: 把 neither 或 nor 置于句首，主谓倒装，表示「也（不）……」，用于承接前面的否定句。本课承接「不觉得奇怪」，用 Neither was I surprise 表示「我也不惊讶」。

examples.en: Neither was I surprise when the train stopped at Widley, a tiny station a few miles along the line.
examples.cn: 火车开出几英里即在一个小站威德里停了下来。对此，我不觉得奇怪。

exercises.q: Ships may be ______ by storms; flights may be cancelled because of bad weather, but trains must be on time.
It suddenly ______ on me that this express was not roaring down the line at ninety miles an hour, but barely chugging along at thirty.
______ was I surprise when the train stopped at Widley, a tiny station a few miles along the line.
下列哪个词与课文中 punctual 的含义最接近？
用被动语态填空：Even a mighty express train can ______ ______ (hold up) by signals.（写出 hold up 的正确被动形式，两个词）
